note: The CGATS input bytes are copied into the parser-owned MemoryBlock, including many repeated table sections.
The parser source pointer is set to the input-controlled MemoryBlock so subsequent parsing tokens are driven by the candidate file.
After each END_DATA that is not end-of-file, control enters the path that creates a new table for the following input text.
Each repeated table section causes another AllocTable call, incrementing TablesCount until it reaches the fixed Tab capacity.
The code derives a TABLE pointer from TablesCount without enforcing the required TablesCount < MAXTABLES bound.
When TablesCount has reached MAXTABLES, t points past the Tab array and this initialization writes out of bounds.
